rows.label: A
rows.condition: WPW PATTERN on EKG/ECG - Incidental finding on EKG/ECG - NO symptoms - Never required treatment
rows.condition_html:
A. WPW PATTERN on EKG/ECG

  • Incidental finding on EKG/ECG
  • NO symptoms
  • Never required treatment
rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: - 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating electrophysiologist or cardiologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up. - 2. It must specifically include if the diagnosis is WPW pattern, WPW syndrome, or other. - 3. Echocardiogram (Echo). Report from a 2-D and Doppler flow study performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. - 4. 24-hour cardiac monitor performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. ≥ 24-hour cardiac monitor (such as a Holter, Zio Patch, etc.). It should have atrial and ventricular ectopic counts; hourly tabular data to include the longest pause duration and counts of all pauses > 2.0 or 2.5 seconds; heart rate (max, min, and average); other histograms and frequency graphs; and percentage of atrial fibrillation/flutter. - 5. Exercise stress test (EST) performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. - 6. Other testing. Copies of any testing deemed clinically necessary by the treating physician.
